name: WebserviceNew
description: create a Webservice Proxy object, a reference to a remote webservice

params.name: url
params.description:
URL of the remote webservice, for example:

- [http://www.whatever.com/Weather.html?wsdl](http://www.whatever.com/Weather.html?wsdl)
- [http://www.whatever.com/Weather.cfc](http://www.whatever.com/Weather.cfc)

params.name: args
params.description: a struct containing the following optional keys (username,password,proxyServer,proxyPort,proxyUser,proxyPassword)
